# Successful Fixture Output Catalog

<!-- This file is generated by scripts/generate-render-fixtures.sh. Do not edit it directly. -->

This catalog lists the input and CLI output for each successful fixture in `tests/fixtures/render`. The images are generated from colorized standard output with [Freeze](https://github.com/charmbracelet/freeze).

Cargo and Go are required to update the catalog. Run the following command from the repository root:

```sh
./scripts/generate-render-fixtures.sh
```

## Featured Example

The [`order-model`](#order-model) fixture is a representative, practical schema. It demonstrates the CLI's typical output without attempting to cover every supported keyword.

## anchor-references

[Source](../tests/fixtures/render/anchor-references.json)

### Input

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "https://example.test/root.json",
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "rootValue": {
      "$ref": "#value"
    },
    "childValue": {
      "$ref": "child.json#value"
    }
  },
  "$defs": {
    "rootValue": {
      "$anchor": "value",
      "type": "string"
    },
    "child": {
      "$id": "child.json",
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "value": {
          "$anchor": "value",
          "type": "integer"
        },
        "rootValue": {
          "$ref": "root.json#value"
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## annotations

### Input

{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$vocabulary": {

    "https://example.test/vocab/order": false
  },
  "$comment": "Used by schema maintainers only.\nKeep this out of the compact view.",

  "description": "Purchase orders shared across teams and systems.\nThis sentence makes the summary longer than the normal display limit.",

  "default": {
    "status": "draft",
    "items": []

  "examples": [

      "id": "A-100"
    },

      "id": "B-200"
    }

  "deprecated": true,
  "properties": {

      "type": "string",
      "readOnly": true

    "payload": {
      "type": "string",
      "writeOnly": true,
      "contentEncoding": "base64",
      "contentMediaType": "application/json",
      "contentSchema": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "status": {
            "type": "string"
          }
        }
      }
    },
    "detached": {
      "type": "string",
      "contentSchema": {
        "type": "integer"
      }

}

## conditional-schema-dependencies

[Source](../tests/fixtures/render/conditional-schema-dependencies.json)

### Input

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$defs": {
    "Address": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "postalCode": {
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": ["postalCode"]
    }
  },
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "kind": {
      "type": "string"
    },
    "billingAddress": {
      "type": "object"
    }
  },
  "dependentSchemas": {
    "billingAddress": {
      "properties": {
        "billingCountry": {
          "type": "string"
        }
      },
      "required": ["billingCountry"]
    },
    "recursive": {
      "$ref": "#"
    }
  },
  "if": {
    "properties": {
      "kind": {
        "const": "digital"
      }
    },
    "required": ["kind"]
  },
  "then": {
    "properties": {
      "downloadUrl": {
        "type": "string",
        "format": "uri"
      }
    },
    "required": ["downloadUrl"]
  },
  "else": {
    "properties": {
      "shippingAddress": {
        "$ref": "#/$defs/Address"
      }
    },
    "required": ["shippingAddress"]
  }
}
```

### Output

![CLI output for conditional-schema-dependencies](assets/render-fixtures/conditional-schema-dependencies.png)
